compiled_state.title: Wire enforcement-gate into pre-commit-review-gate.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3a: gating hooks short-circuit (review-gate portion) — pre-commit-review-gate.sh sources enforcement-gate.sh and short-circuits with HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci on ci
- DD6 (partial): audit criterion A — review gate still runs on local

## Description
After the existing `set -uo pipefail` and trap setup but BEFORE any `git diff --cached` call in plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh, add:

```bash
source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/lib/enforcement-gate.sh"
_dso_enforcement_gate_check && exit 0
```

The library guards against double-source. This turns 4 RED tests green: review-gate ci-skip, schema, both no-double-execution, both runs-once.

**IMPORTANT** — read tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh before implementing. The `test_enforcement_both_runs_once` test may grep for a `HOOK_GATE: run` marker. The current `_dso_enforcement_gate_check` only emits `HOOK_GATE: skipped` on ci. If the test requires a `run` marker, EITHER (a) update enforcement-gate.sh to emit `HOOK_GATE: run reason=enforcement.strategy=both` to stderr when strategy=both (and when local/absent), OR (b) confirm by reading the test that observed side effects suffice. Document the chosen path in the commit message.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh (modify)
- (conditionally) plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh (modify if HOOK_GATE: run marker required by test)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Review-gate enforcement RED tests are now GREEN
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "test_enforcement_ci_review_gate_skips|test_hook_gate_schema_review_gate|test_enforcement_both_no_double_execution|test_enforcement_both_runs_once" | grep -c PASS | awk '$1 >= 4'
- [ ] enforcement-gate.sh sourced exactly once
  Verify: test "$(grep -c 'enforcement-gate.sh' plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh)" -eq 1
- [ ] Review gate still blocks on local mode (smoke)
  Verify: bash -c 'tmp=$(mktemp -d); echo "enforcement.strategy=local" > "$tmp/conf"; ! WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$tmp/conf" bash plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh </dev/null 2>/dev/null; rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; test $rc -ne 0'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
